source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Change all/random setting to non-default in this BIOS function.
3. Save and reboot.
4. Boot in to BIOS and  check your setting still exist.
5. Press load default,save and reboot.
6. Boot in to BIOS,setting in this function should match the SPEC.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. No error log happen.
2. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
3. Check your setting still exist.
4. The default setting should matches SPEC."

original_test_intent: Verify that approved non-default values on the Advanced ACPI Settings page persist across save/reboot and that Load Default restores their SPEC values without reboot, ACPI, device-enumeration or OS stability errors.
original_method: Change BIOS ACPI settings, save/reboot and re-enter BIOS to verify persistence; then Load Default, save/reboot, re-enter BIOS and compare the fields with SPEC while checking logs and normal reboot behavior.
manual_activity: A human must navigate the ACPI page, set each approved value, invoke both save/reboot cycles, select Load Default and visually inspect persistence/default restoration. OS inventory automation is supporting evidence only.
required_inputs: Named ACPI fields with baseline, safe non-default and SPEC-default values
Expected ACPI table, power and device-enumeration effects
Console/operator, stable power and OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random; name and approve every field/value.
Review dependencies among sleep/power, interrupt, PCI resource and device-discovery controls.
Protect active workloads and mounted/in-use storage from unapproved power or enumeration changes.
Stop on hang, crash, boot loss, device disappearance or management loss.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only ACPI table summaries, PCI/storage/network inventory, OS/BMC logs and health.
Compare operator BIOS captures and before/after device state with the approved matrix.
Do not drive BIOS, select ACPI values, perform unapproved power transitions or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Define/approve the bounded ACPI matrix, expected OS/device effects and recovery.
Perform/capture non-default persistence and default-restoration phases.
Evaluate firmware and downstream OS/device evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly states the BIOS control path is not runnable by the agent. No source command exists; platform-selected OS inventory commands must remain read-only and cannot replace firmware evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the manual BIOS sequence and add approved read-only ACPI-table, PCI and device inventory snapshots appropriate to the OS; do not inject ACPI overrides or use OS power commands as substitutes.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The two save/reboot phases, no-script state and 5/20-minute fields are preserved; all/random remains source text but is bounded for safe execution.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map each approved field to its firmware value, expected ACPI/table or device effect, and SPEC default; capture BIOS and OS/PCI/device state at baseline, non-default persistence, default restoration and final configuration.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BIOS/ACPI implementation, CPU/chipset and installed OS.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS, BMC, kernel/OS and inventory-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform ACPI setting specification and project hardware/OS topology.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds per-field downstream observability and rejects random mutation while preserving both source state transitions.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; it increases causal evidence for in-scope fields and documents exclusions.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: ACPI field/default matrix and expected table/device relationships.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some firmware changes alter multiple ACPI objects; correlation must not be asserted without platform documentation.

project_override_considerations: The project may choose a safe subset and duration/health checks. Completion applies to that approved matrix only and must not be reported as coverage of every ACPI field or random combinations.
expected_evidence: Identity, approval, ACPI/PCI/device baseline and recovery readiness
First save/reboot persistence captures and OS/device comparison
Load Default, second save/reboot, SPEC values and normal-boot/no-hang evidence
Logs, final inventory/configuration and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently require persistence followed by SPEC-default restoration and normal reboot/log behavior. Unsafe all/random scope is an execution-detail deficiency, not an opposing source fact.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The two-phase ACPI intent is clear. Missing field/default/effect matrices are project readiness inputs and do not make this Master Library case permanently BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees with manual BIOS classification and adds ACPI-specific downstream evidence and safety.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its ACPI/PCI/device and recovery controls while distinguishing readiness from classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Defines project subset reporting, supporting automation and formal verdict separation.

review_improvement: Prevents arbitrary ACPI combinations from causing unexplained device or power failures and ties each approved firmware change to an observable platform effect.
independent_technical_reasoning: The core acceptance requires repeated observation of pre-OS fields and manual Load Default operation, so the case is MANUAL ONLY. OS automation strengthens evidence but cannot prove that the firmware UI persisted and restored the intended fields.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat a field change, reboot or default load after any hang, crash, device delta or ambiguous result; preserve BIOS and OS evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
